questions.title: Climate and Weather
questions.content: Climate is the word we {use, estimate, predict, describe} for weather over a long period of time. The desert has a dry climate because there is very little rain. The UK {has, is, are, be} a 'temperate climate', {which, what, these, that} means winters are, overall, mild and {summers, winter, desert, dessert} generally, don't get too hot.
questions.contentTranslation: 气候是我们用来描述长时间天气的词。沙漠气候干燥是因为几乎没有降雨。英国有一个'温带气候'，这意味着冬季总体上温和，夏季通常不会太热。

blanks.explanation: 这里选择'use'是因为我们'使用'词语来描述概念，而不是估计、预测或仅仅描述天气。
选择'has'是因为英国'拥有'温带气候，这里指的是一种特征或属性。'is'不合适因为不是表示等同关系，'are'和'be'在语法上不正确。
选择'which'是因为需要引导非限制性定语从句来解释'temperate climate'这个概念。'which'在这里引导解释性从句，比'that'更适合用于非限制性定语从句。
选择'summers'是因为文章前面提到冬季情况，这里需要与之形成对比，谈论夏季的特点。逻辑上，我们期望了解温带气候冬季和夏季的特点。

questions.title: Ice Age and Ocean Currents
questions.content: At the end of the last ice age, the melting ice disrupted the ocean currents in the North Atlantic and {caused, denied, reflected, featured} a drop in temperature of almost 5 degrees. {Even though, contrasting to, as if, now that} the rest of the planet was warming {up, in, off, back}, the North Atlantic region remained in a cold period for 1300 years. The same thing happened {around, after, before, on} 8000 years ago, when the cooling lasted about a hundred years, and it {could, should, can, could have} happen again today. Even a short period of cooling in the North Atlantic could have a dramatic effect on the wildlife, and the human populations, living there.
questions.contentTranslation: 在上一个冰河时期结束时，融化的冰破坏了北大西洋的海洋洋流，导致温度下降了近5度。尽管地球其他地区正在变暖，北大西洋地区仍然处于寒冷期长达1300年。同样的事情大约在8000年前也发生过，当时寒冷持续了大约一百年，今天这种情况可能再次发生。即使是北大西洋短暂的寒冷时期也可能对那里的野生动物和人类产生巨大影响。

blanks.explanation: 融化的冰'导致'了温度下降，表示因果关系。
'Even though'（尽管）表示让步关系，后面的情况与预期相反。
'warming up'是正确的词组，表示升温或变暖。
'around'用于时间表示'大约'，符合上下文的表达。
'could'表示可能性，与后文的假设情景一致。

questions.title: Early Years Education and Childcare
questions.content: Affordable early years education and childcare potentially enables parents, particularly mothers, to be in paid employment. International studies {have found, have been found, found, have yet to find} that countries with greater enrolment rates in publicly funded or provided childcare also have higher maternal employment rates, although untangling causal relationships is complex. From the point of view of the household, additional income, especially for the less well-off, is itself associated with better outcomes for children, as child poverty {has been shown, have shown, showed, was showing} to be a key independent determinant of children's outcomes. From the point of view of the public purse, as mothers {enter, enact, enacting, entering} employment, they are likely to claim fewer benefits and to generate extra revenues {through, within, by, throughout} income tax and national insurance contributions.
questions.contentTranslation: 负担得起的幼儿教育和托儿服务有可能使父母，尤其是母亲，能够从事有偿工作。国际研究发现，公共资助或提供的托儿服务入学率较高的国家，母亲的就业率也较高，尽管厘清因果关系很复杂。从家庭的角度来看，额外的收入，尤其是对经济较差的家庭，与儿童更好的结果相关，因为儿童贫困被证明是影响儿童结果的一个关键独立因素。从公共财政的角度来看，随着母亲进入就业市场，她们可能会减少领取福利，并通过所得税和国家保险缴纳额外的收入。

blanks.explanation: 选择'have found'是因为国际研究主动发现了这个事实，表示主动行为且符合现在完成时态。
选择'has been shown'是因为儿童贫困被研究证明是关键因素，使用被动语态和现在完成时态表示已确认的结果。
选择'enter'是因为母亲'进入'就业市场，动词原形符合语法和语义需求。
选择'through'是因为额外收入通过税收和保险缴纳产生，表示途径，符合固定搭配。

questions.title: Ancient Egyptian Health
questions.content: You've probably heard the {expression, intestine, formalism, discussion, attention} 'a heart attack on a plate.' Because a report in the Journal of the American Medical Association reveals that some Egyptian mummies show signs of atherosclerosis, {hardening, bloodcurdling, fathering, unraveling} of the arteries. Intrigued by this observation, {scientists, hyperlinks, likenesses, ripeness} from the University of California, Irvine, got to wondering whether damaged arteries were common among ancient Egyptians. So they collected 20 mummies from the museum basement and from various displays, and {subjected, subjective, resubmitted, undetected, retrofitted} them to whole-body CT scans to look at their insides. Although no one knows what those mummies were eating, it's safe to say they never {encountered, dowered, domiciled, doveled} a corn dog. Too many of those things will lead you to an early tomb.
questions.contentTranslation: 你可能听说过{expression, intestine, formalism, discussion, attention}‘盘子上的心脏病发作’。因为《美国医学会杂志》的一篇报告显示，一些埃及木乃伊有动脉粥样硬化的迹象，即动脉的{hardening, bloodcurdling, fathering, unraveling}。对此观察感到好奇，加州大学尔湾分校的{scientists, hyperlinks, likenesses, ripeness}开始思考受损动脉在古埃及人中是否普遍。于是，他们从博物馆地下室和各种展览中收集了20具木乃伊，并将其{subjected, subjective, resubmitted, undetected, retrofitted}进行全身CT扫描以查看内部。虽然没人知道这些木乃伊吃过什么，但可以肯定地说，他们从未{encountered, dowered, domiciled, doveled}过玉米热狗。吃太多这类东西会让你早早进入坟墓。

blanks.explanation: 选择'expression'是因为‘盘子上的心脏病发作’是一个常见的表达方式，指某种不健康的食物，与上下文描述相符。
选择'hardening'是因为动脉粥样硬化指的是动脉的‘硬化’，这是医学上的正确术语。
选择'scientists'是因为加州大学的研究人员是科学家，他们对木乃伊进行研究，符合逻辑。
选择'subjected'是因为木乃伊被‘置于’CT扫描中，表示被动接受检查，语法和语义正确。
选择'encountered'是因为古埃及人从未‘遇到’过玉米热狗，这是一种现代食物，符合历史背景。

questions.title: Choosing an MBA Program
questions.content: Deciding to go to business school is perhaps the simplest part of what can be a complicated process. With nearly 600 accredited MBA programs on {offer, offering, offered, to offer} around the world, the choice of where to study can be overwhelming. Here we explain how to {choose, elect, recognize, identify} the right school and course for you and unravel the application and funding process. 'Probably the {majority, few, many, most} of people applying to business school are at a point in their careers where they know they {want, enjoy, hesitate, choose} to shake things up, but they don't know exactly what they would like to do with their professional lives,' says Stacy Blackman, an MBA admissions consultant based in Los Angeles. 'If that's the case with you, look at other {criteria, standards, vectors, rules}: culture, teaching method, location, and then pick a place that's a good fit for you with a strong general management program. Super-defined career goals don't have to be a part of this process.'
questions.contentTranslation: 决定上商学院可能是复杂过程中的最简单部分。全球有近600个经过认证的MBA项目可供{offer, offering, offered, to offer}，选择在哪里学习可能会让人不知所措。这里我们解释如何{choose, elect, recognize, identify}适合你的学校和课程，并解析申请和资助流程。‘可能申请商学院的{majority, few, many, most}人在职业生涯中到了一个阶段，他们知道自己{want, enjoy, hesitate, choose}改变现状，但不确定职业生涯具体想做什么，’洛杉矶的MBA招生顾问Stacy Blackman说。‘如果你是这种情况，看看其他{criteria, standards, vectors, rules}：文化、教学方法、地点，然后选择一个适合你的地方，拥有强大的综合管理项目。非常明确的事业目标不必是这个过程的一部分。’

blanks.explanation: 选择'offer'是因为‘on offer’是固定搭配，表示‘提供’或‘可供选择’，符合句意和语法。
选择'choose'是因为这里指的是‘选择’适合的学校和课程，与上下文目标一致。
选择'majority'是因为它表示‘大多数’，符合描述申请商学院的人群数量的逻辑。
选择'want'是因为申请者‘想要’改变现状，表示意愿，与句意相符。
选择'criteria'是因为这里指的是选择学校的‘标准’或‘条件’，如文化和地点，符合语境。

questions.title: Music in Ancient Egypt
questions.content: Music was as important to the ancient Egyptians as it is in our modern society. Although it is thought that music played a {role, game, response, situation} throughout the history of Egypt, those that {study, need, require, confirm} the Egyptian writings have discovered that music {like, predict, seemed} to become more important in what is called the 'pharaonic' {people, place, race, period} of their history. This was the time when the Egyptian dynasties of the pharaohs were {established, contributed, raised, constructed} (around 3100 BCE) and music was {found in, found at, found from} many parts of everyday Egyptian life.
questions.contentTranslation: 音乐对古埃及人来说和对我们现代社会一样重要。虽然人们认为音乐在埃及历史上扮演了一个{role, game, response, situation}，那些{study, need, require, confirm}埃及文字的人发现，音乐在所谓的‘法老’{people, place, race, period}中{like, predict, seemed}变得更加重要。这是法老埃及王朝{established, contributed, raised, constructed}的时期（大约公元前3100年），音乐被{found in, found at, found from}埃及人日常生活的许多部分。

blanks.explanation: 选择'role'是因为音乐在历史中‘扮演角色’，表示其重要性，符合句意。
选择'study'是因为研究埃及文字的人发现了音乐的重要性，表示主动研究行为。
选择'seem'是因为这里表示音乐‘似乎’变得更重要，基于发现而非确定事实。
选择'period'是因为‘法老时期’指的是历史时间段，与上下文时间描述一致。
选择'established'是因为王朝被‘建立’，表示创建，符合历史事件描述。
选择'found in'是因为音乐存在于日常生活的‘各个部分中’，表示分布，符合搭配。

questions.title: Fathers' Role in Family
questions.content: With the increase in women's {participation, attendance, substitution, definition} in the labour force, many mothers have less time {available, related, consumable, useful} to undertake domestic activities. At the same time, there has been increasing {recognition, discrimination, resolution, recreation} that the father's role and {relationship, scholarship, worship, employment} with a child is important. A father can have many roles in the family, ranging from income provider to teacher, carer, playmate and role model. Therefore, balancing paid work and family responsibilities can be an important issue for both fathers and mothers in families.
questions.contentTranslation: 随着女性在劳动力中的参与增加，许多母亲有更少的可用时间从事家务活动。与此同时，人们越来越认识到父亲的角色及其与孩子的关系很重要。父亲在家庭中可以扮演多种角色，从收入提供者到教师、看护者、玩伴和榜样。因此，平衡有偿工作和家庭责任对家庭中的父亲和母亲都是一个重要问题。

blanks.explanation: 选择'participation'是因为女性在劳动力中的‘参与’增加，描述她们加入工作的行为。
选择'available'是因为母亲有更少的‘可用’时间，表示时间减少的实际情况。
选择'recognition'是因为人们越来越‘认识到’父亲角色的重要性，表示认知提升。
选择'relationship'是因为父亲与孩子的‘关系’很重要，与角色并列描述。

questions.title: Wind and Weather
questions.content: Wind is air moving around. Some winds can move {as, so, like, than} fast as a racing car, over 100 miles an {hour, second, minute, microsecond}. Winds can travel around the world. Wind can make you feel cold because you lose heat from your body {faster, slower, higher, lower} when it is windy. Weather forecasters need to {know, overshoot, check, fix} the speed and direction of the wind. The strength of wind is measured using the Beaufort scale from wind force when there is no wind, to wind force 12 which can damage houses and buildings and is called hurricane force.
questions.contentTranslation: 风是空气在移动。有些风可以移动得和赛车一样快，超过每小时100英里。风可以环游世界。风会让你感到冷，因为在有风时你从身体失去热量更快。天气预报员需要知道风的速度和方向。风的强度使用蒲福风级来测量，从无风时的风力到能损坏房屋和建筑物的12级风力，称为飓风力。

blanks.explanation: 选择'as'是因为‘as fast as’是固定搭配，表示风速与赛车速度的比较。
选择'hour'是因为风速通常以‘每小时’英里为单位，符合实际测量标准。
选择'faster'是因为风会加速身体热量流失，使人感到更冷，符合物理常识。
选择'know'是因为天气预报员需要‘知道’风速和方向，以进行准确预测。

questions.title: Revision and Timing
questions.content: Timing is important for revision. Have you noticed that during the school day you get times when you just don't care any longer? I don't mean the lessons you don't like, but the ones you usually find OK, but on some occasions, you just can't be bothered with it. You {may, should, might, must} have other things on your mind, be tired, restless, or looking forward to what comes next. Whatever the reason, that particular lesson doesn't get 100 percent {effort, satisfaction, effect, affect} from you. The same is true of revision. Your mental and physical {attitude, concern, support, health} is important. You need a revision timetable, so you don't keep {putting it off, stopping, giving it up, putting out}.
questions.contentTranslation: 复习的时机很重要。你有没有注意到，在学校一天中，有时你会完全不在乎？我不是说你不喜欢的课程，而是那些你通常觉得还行的课程，但在某些时候，你就是提不起兴趣。你可能会因为其他事情分心，感到疲倦、不安，或者期待接下来的活动。不管原因是什么，那节课无法从你那里得到100%的努力。复习也是如此。你的精神和身体态度很重要。你需要一个复习时间表，这样你就不会一直推迟。

blanks.explanation: 选择'may'是因为这里表示‘可能’有其他事情分心，语气较温和且符合推测。
选择'effort'是因为课程无法得到你的‘努力’，表示主动投入，与句意相符。
选择'attitude'是因为复习需要正确的‘态度’，指心理状态，符合上下文。
选择'putting it off'是因为时间表避免你‘推迟’复习，表示拖延，符合语境。

questions.title: Children and Music
questions.content: The general perception is that children are {surrounded, deterred, deferred, characterized} by a variety of musical experiences. There are often fewer and fewer opportunities for children to actively engage in music making themselves. They are inundated with music emitting from a wide {array, appointment, access, arrangement} of electronic devices, toys, and computers offering a {limitless, plunging, excessive, spacious} number of musical selections. However, much of the music in children's lives is 'unchosen', in other words they are {passive, dormant, bilateral, active} recipients in much of the music in their lives, and not actively engaged in its selection. Studies are being {conducted, abandoned, culminated, confided} on the effects of the ubiquitous pre - recorded music they encounter and whether or not it {is intruding, can have intruded, would have intruded, has intruded} on their desire to make their own music or interact with each other on the playground.
questions.contentTranslation: 普遍看法是，儿童被各种音乐体验包围。儿童主动参与音乐创作的机会越来越少。他们被来自各种电子设备、玩具和电脑的广泛音乐所淹没，这些设备提供无限的音乐选择。然而，儿童生活中的大部分音乐是‘未被选择的’，换句话说，他们是生活中大部分音乐的被动接受者，而不是主动参与选择。研究正在对他们遇到的无处不在的预录音乐的影响进行开展，以及它是否正在干扰他们自己创作音乐或在操场上互动的愿望。

blanks.explanation: 选择'surrounded'是因为儿童被音乐体验‘包围’，表示广泛接触，符合句意。
选择'array'是因为这里指‘一系列’电子设备，表示多样性，与语境一致。
选择'limitless'是因为音乐选择‘无限’，强调数量多，符合描述。
选择'passive'是因为儿童是音乐的‘被动’接受者，与‘未选择’对应。
选择'conducted'是因为研究正在被‘进行’，表示主动研究，符合时态。
选择'is intruding'是因为这里询问音乐是否‘正在干扰’，现在进行时符合语境。

questions.title: Biological Systems and Natural Selection
questions.content: Since biological systems with signs of {complex, complimentary, compensatory, compendious} engineering are unlikely to have arisen from accidents or coincidences, their {organization, compilation, eccentricity, metabolism} must come from natural selection, and hence should have {functions, intentions, attentions, evaluations} useful for survival and reproduction in the environments in which humans evolved.
questions.contentTranslation: 由于带有复杂工程迹象的生物系统不太可能从偶然或巧合中产生，它们的组织必须来自自然选择，因此应该具有在人类进化环境中对生存和繁殖有用的功能。

blanks.explanation: 选择'complex'是因为生物系统被描述为具有‘复杂的’工程迹象，表示高度发展和结构化，符合上下文。
选择'organization'是因为生物系统的‘组织’指的是其结构和排列，由自然选择形成。
选择'functions'是因为生物系统应具有‘功能’，对生存和繁殖有用，符合自然选择逻辑。

questions.title: Cattle Trade Ban
questions.content: Good sense appears to have {prevailed, prevented, precluded, presented} at last. With a fresh set of draft rules to replace last year's poorly conceived ones, the centre has sought to withdraw the ban on sale of cattle for slaughter in animal markets. There was {concern, dispute, belief, recognition} that in the name of preventing cruelty to animals and regulating livestock markets the government was surreptitiously throttling the cattle trade and furthering the BJP's cow protection agenda. The rules were criticized for restricting legitimate animal trade and interfering with {dietary, intake, nutritional, daily} habits.
questions.contentTranslation: 理智似乎终于占了上风。中心通过一套新的草案规则，取代去年构思不佳的规则，试图撤销动物市场上出售用于屠宰的牛的禁令。有人担心，以防止虐待动物和监管牲畜市场为名，政府在暗中扼杀牛贸易并推进BJP的牛保护议程。这些规则因限制合法动物贸易和干扰饮食习惯而受到批评。

blanks.explanation: 选择'prevailed'是因为‘占上风’表示理智最终胜出，符合积极结果的语境。
选择'concern'是因为这里表示人们‘担心’政府行为，符合负面情绪描述。
选择'dietary'是因为规则干扰‘饮食’习惯，指食物选择，与牛肉相关。

questions.title: Mass Extinction of Marine Life
questions.content: Scientists have discovered the cause of a mass extinction of sea - floor marine organisms 800,000 years ago — which also provides insight into how climate change can impact {on, in, of, off} deep ocean biota. In a new study {published, publishing, has published, be publishing} in the journal Nature Communications, scientists from the universities of Nottingham and Durham and the British Geological Survey (BGS), have discovered the cause of a mass extinction within marine organisms called foraminifera. Foraminifera are an important group in relation to biomass in the deep ocean and the cause of their extinction was {previously, Occasionally, necessarily, currently} unknown. Scientists tested various possible {causes, consequences, elements, factors} for the mass extinction and were able to discount others such as ocean cooling. {Instead, So, Thus, However}, they discovered that the extinction was caused by a global change in plankton at the surface of the ocean.
questions.contentTranslation: 科学家们发现了80万年前海底海洋生物大规模灭绝原因——这也提供了气候变化如何影响深海生物群的见解。在《自然通讯》期刊上发表的一项新研究中，来自诺丁汉大学、达勒姆大学和英国地质调查局（BGS）的科学家们发现了被称为有孔虫的海洋生物大规模灭绝的原因。有孔虫是深海生物量的重要群体，其灭绝原因之前未知。科学家们测试了大规模灭绝的各种可能原因，并排除了其他因素，如海洋冷却。相反，他们发现灭绝是由海洋表面浮游生物的全球变化引起的。

blanks.explanation: 选择'on'是因为‘impact on’是固定搭配，表示对深海生物群的影响。
选择'published'是因为研究‘已发表’，过去分词符合句法和语义。
选择'previously'是因为灭绝原因‘之前’未知，与发现相对应。
选择'causes'是因为科学家测试灭绝的‘原因’，与研究目的一致。
选择'Instead'是因为这里表示‘相反’，与排除其他原因形成对比。

questions.title: Classical Music in China
questions.content: Away from the rumble of Shanghai's highways and the cacophony of the shopping districts, stroll down side streets filled with rows of tall brick {houses, rooms, huts, piles}. In the early evening or on a weekend morning, you'll hear the {sound, impact, effect, noise} of classical music drifting from a piano, played by a 10-year old or a grandmother in her seventies. Wander down another alley toward concrete {skyscraper, craters, museum, court} and you'll hear Beethoven or Mozart flowing from a violin, or perhaps a cello, accordion or flute. In China, classical music is {booming, looming, bluffing, changing} as mightily as the 1812 Overture.
questions.contentTranslation: 远离上海高速公路的轰鸣和购物区的嘈杂，漫步在两旁排列着高大砖房的侧街。在傍晚或周末早晨，你会听到由10岁孩子或70多岁祖母弹奏的钢琴传来的古典音乐的声音。沿着另一条小巷走向混凝土摩天大楼，你会听到小提琴、或许是大提琴、手风琴或长笛传来的贝多芬或莫扎特乐曲。在中国，古典音乐正如《1812序曲》般蓬勃发展。

blanks.explanation: 选择'houses'是因为侧街两旁是‘房屋’，符合城市环境描述。
选择'sound'是因为这里指古典音乐的‘声音’，强调悦耳，与‘noise’区别。
选择'skyscraper'是因为上海有‘摩天大楼’，符合现代城市背景。
选择'booming'是因为古典音乐在‘蓬勃发展’，表示快速增长，符合比喻。

questions.title: Edible Insects
questions.content: Fancy a locust for lunch? Probably not, if you live in the west, but elsewhere it's a different story. Edible insects, termites, stick insects, dragonflies , grasshoppers and giant water bugs, are on the menu for an estimated 80 percent of the world's population. For example, 'Kungu cakes', made from midges, are a {delicacy, taboo, ointment, symbol} in parts of Africa. {Demand, grade, pressure, risk} is so high that 40 species are now under threat, including white agave worms. These caterpillars of the tequila giant-skipper butterfly {fetch, strike, accumulate, add} around $250 a kilogram. Insects can be a good {source, derivative, substitute, replica} of vitamins and minerals too: a type of caterpillar (Usta Terpsichore) eaten in Angola is rich in iron, zinc, and thiamine.
questions.contentTranslation: 想吃蝗虫当午餐吗？如果你住在西方，可能不会，但在其他地方情况不同。可食用昆虫，如白蚁、竹节虫、蜻蜓、蚱蜢和巨型水虱，是全球约80%人口的菜单上的一部分。例如，由蚊虫制成的‘Kungu蛋糕’在非洲部分地区是一种美味。对它们的需求如此之高，以至于40种昆虫现在面临威胁，包括白色龙舌兰蠕虫。这些龙舌兰巨型蝴蝶的幼虫每公斤能卖大约250美元。昆虫也可以是维生素和矿物质的良好来源：在安哥拉食用的一种毛虫（Usta Terpsichore）富含铁、锌和硫胺素。

blanks.explanation: 选择'delicacy'是因为‘Kungu蛋糕’在非洲被视为‘美味’，表示受欢迎的食物。
选择'Demand'是因为对昆虫的‘需求’高，导致物种受威胁，符合逻辑。
选择'fetch'是因为蠕虫‘卖’到250美元，表示价格，符合商业语境。
选择'source'是因为昆虫是维生素的‘来源’，表示提供养分。

questions.title: Physical Activity and Health
questions.content: Participating regularly in physical activity has been shown to benefit an individual's health and {wellbeing, values, immortality, expectation}. Regular physical activity is important in reducing the risk of {chronic, contraindicated, untouched, detectable} diseases, such as heart disease and stroke, obesity, diabetes and some forms of cancer. The National Physical Activity Guidelines for Adults {recommends, excludes, defies, denotes} at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity, {preferably, relatively, absolutely, namely} every day of the week, to {obtain, charge, weigh, estimate} health benefits.
questions.contentTranslation: 定期参与体育活动已被证明有益于个人的健康和幸福。定期体育活动在降低慢性疾病风险（如心脏病、中风、肥胖、糖尿病和某些癌症）方面很重要。《成人国家体育活动指南》推荐每周每天至少进行30分钟的中等强度体育活动，最好是为了获得健康益处。

blanks.explanation: 选择'wellbeing'是因为体育活动有益于‘幸福’，指身心健康，符合语境。
选择'chronic'是因为这里指‘慢性’疾病，如心脏病，符合医学背景。
选择'recommends'是因为指南‘推荐’活动量，表示建议，符合语义。
选择'preferably'是因为‘最好’每天活动，表示优先建议。
选择'obtain'是因为活动为了‘获得’健康益处，表示目的。

questions.title: Newspapers and News
questions.content: Who won the World Cup 1994 football game? What happened at the United Nations? How did the critics like the new play? Just when an event takes place, newspapers are on the streets {to give, be giving, have given, given} the details. Wherever anything happens in the world, reporters are on the spot to {gather, read, subscribe, invent} the news. They quickly made use of the newer and faster means of communication to improve the {speed, column, rating, volume} and thus the efficiency of their own operations. Besides keeping readers {informed, besieged, fed, confirmed} of the latest news, today's newspapers educate and influence readers about politics and other important and serious matters. This is {measured, envisioned, engaged, entailed} in terms of circulation.
questions.contentTranslation: 谁赢得了1994年世界杯足球赛？联合国发生了什么？评论家如何评价新剧？事件一发生，报纸就上街头提供细节。无论世界上哪里发生了什么事，记者都在现场收集新闻。他们迅速利用更新、更快的通信方式来提高速度，从而提高自身运作效率。除了让读者了解最新新闻外，今天的报纸还教育和影响读者关于政治和其他重要严肃事务。这以发行量来衡量。

blanks.explanation: 选择'to give'是因为报纸上街‘提供’细节，表示目的，符合语法。
选择'gather'是因为记者‘收集’新闻，表示主动获取信息。
选择'speed'是因为通信方式提高‘速度’，与效率相关。
选择'informed'是因为报纸让读者‘了解’新闻，表示传递信息。
选择'measured'是因为影响以发行量‘衡量’，表示评估方式。

questions.title: Contexts Magazine
questions.content: Contexts is a quarterly magazine of the American Sociological Association about society and social behavior. Directed to {anyone, someone, whom, nobody} interested in the latest sociological ideas and research, Contexts seeks to apply new knowledge, stimulate fresh thinking, and disseminate important information {covered, shaded, produced, overcome} by the discipline. The publication's articles synthesize key findings, weave {about, together, into, regardless} diverse strands of work, draw out implications for policy, and debate issues of controversy. By design, it is not a technical journal, {and, but, also, never} a magazine for diverse readers, {them, those, they, others} who wish to be current about social science knowledge, emerging trends, and their relevance.
questions.contentTranslation: 《Contexts》是美国社会学协会的季刊杂志，内容关于社会和社会行为。面向对最新社会学思想和研究感兴趣的任何人，《Contexts》旨在应用新知识，激发新思维，并传播学科产生的重要信息。该刊物的文章综合关键发现，将不同的工作线索编织在一起，得出政策含义，并讨论有争议的问题。按设计，它不是技术期刊，而是面向希望了解社会科学知识、新兴趋势及其相关性的各种读者的杂志。

blanks.explanation: 选择'anyone'是因为杂志面向‘任何人’，表示广泛读者群。
选择'produced'是因为信息由学科‘产生’，表示来源，符合语义。
选择'together'是因为文章将工作线索‘编织在一起’，表示整合。
选择'but'是因为它不是技术期刊，‘而是’面向读者的杂志，表示转折。
选择'those'是因为指‘那些’希望了解知识的读者，符合定语从句。

questions.title: Film Narratives
questions.content: The universality of story feature films are narratives – they tell stories. Even films based on {true, prehistoric, common, harsh} events will fictionalize them in order to produce drama, to telescope time, to avoid being filled up with too many {minor, objective, sheer, marginalized} characters ,or simply to be more entertaining. Even in the current welter of special-effect movies, feature films are usually summarized by their plots – in their first 'treatment' (or outline of the script or the advance publicity), in the TV guide, in reviews, and in conversations. Films may differ from other {kinds, amounts, properties, qualities} of narrative– literary fiction or television drama, for instance – in the medium used and the representational conventions. They do, however, {share, spare, abide with, conform with} with literary fiction and television drama the basic structure and functions of narrative.
questions.contentTranslation: 故事的普遍性特征电影是叙事性的——它们讲述故事。即使是基于真实事件的电影也会虚构它们，以制造戏剧性、压缩时间、避免充斥过多次要角色，或者仅仅是为了更具娱乐性。即使在当前特效电影的混乱中，故事片通常由其情节概括——在它们的首次‘处理’（或剧本大纲或预告宣传）、电视指南、评论和对话中。电影可能在使用的媒介和表现惯例上与其他类型的叙事（如文学小说或电视剧）有所不同。然而，它们与文学小说和电视剧共享叙事的基本结构和功能。

blanks.explanation: 选择'true'是因为电影基于‘真实’事件，但仍需虚构，符合语境。
选择'minor'是因为避免过多‘次要’角色，保持故事简洁。
选择'kinds'是因为电影与其他‘类型’的叙事不同，表示类别。
选择'share'是因为电影与小说等‘共享’叙事结构，表示共同点。

questions.title: Online and Distance Learning
questions.content: If you are interested in studying but have other {commitments, options, decisions, barriers}, our online and distance learning courses offer an alternative flexible {mode, venue, tariff, rate} of study. Teaching is conducted through a mixture of audio - visual, written and interactive materials. There are also {opportunities, displacements, exaggerations, impressions} for online discussion and collaborative projects with tutors and other students. Some programs include residential {modules, disclaimers, belongs, exercises} taught on campus, giving you the chance to meet and work alongside your tutors and fellow students face - to - face. Our Graduate School provides comprehensive support for distance and part - time researchers, many of whom study for up to six years or more.
questions.contentTranslation: 如果你对学习感兴趣但有其他承诺，我们的在线和远程学习课程提供了一种灵活的学习方式。教学通过视听、书面和互动材料的混合方式进行。还有与导师和其他学生进行在线讨论和协作项目的机会。一些课程包括在校园内教授的住宿模块，让你有机会与导师和同学面对面交流和合作。我们的研究生院为远程和兼职研究人员提供全面支持，其中许多人学习长达六年或更长时间。

blanks.explanation: 选择'commitments'是因为有其他‘承诺’限制学习，表示责任。
选择'mode'是因为课程提供‘方式’灵活，表示学习形式。
选择'opportunities'是因为有在线讨论的‘机会’，表示可能性。
选择'modules'是因为课程包括‘模块’，表示教学单元。

questions.title: Stress and Life Changes
questions.content: Research has suggested that major stressors in our lives are life {changes, collections, expectations, appearances}, for example, moving house, marriage or relationship breakdown. Work - related factors, {including, have included, include, included} unemployment and boredom, are also common {causes, conferences, courses, factors} of stress. Differences in personality may also {play, act, give, list} a part.
questions.contentTranslation: 研究表明，我们生活中的主要压力源是生活变化，例如搬家、结婚或关系破裂。与工作相关的因素，包括失业和无聊，也是常见的压力原因。人格差异也可能扮演一部分角色。

blanks.explanation: 选择'changes'是因为压力源是生活‘变化’，如搬家，与例子一致。
选择'including'是因为‘包括’失业等，表示列举，符合现在时。
选择'causes'是因为这些是压力的‘原因’，与主旨一致。
选择'play'是因为人格差异‘扮演’角色，固定搭配‘play a part’。

questions.title: Economics and Human Behavior
questions.content: An economist sees the world basically through a typical micro - economic {toolkit, power, concern, rate}. That involves things like thinking at the margin, rationality, opportunity cost, trade RTS - offs. Economics, like any other {discipline, degree, title, tuition} or dogma, has its own jargon and its own rules, and its own way of seeing the world. So basically economics, or economists in general tend to apply micro - economic {concepts, funds, tariffs, scales} like that to explain the way humans behave and to make {predictions, preferences, reviews, regrets} about the future.
questions.contentTranslation: 经济学家基本上通过典型的微观经济工具包看待世界。这涉及到边缘思维、理性、机会成本、权衡等内容。经济学，像其他学科或教条一样，有自己的术语、规则和看待世界的方式。所以基本上，经济学或经济学家一般倾向于应用这样的微观经济概念来解释人类行为，并对未来做出预测。

blanks.explanation: 选择'toolkit'是因为微观经济‘工具包’指分析方法，符合专业术语。
选择'discipline'是因为经济学是‘学科’，与其他领域并列。
选择'concepts'是因为经济学家应用‘概念’解释行为，如理性等。
选择'predictions'是因为经济学对未来‘预测’，符合学科目标。

questions.title: Odorous House Ants
questions.content: A common response to seeing an ant inside your house is to stomp on it. But if you crush a member of the ant species Tapinoma sessile, you might catch a whiff of a strange smell—a smell that reminds some people of blue cheese, rancid butter or rotten coconut. In fact, the smell is so noticeable that the insect's common name is the 'odorous house ant.' And many people call it the coconut ant. In an effort to figure out why people have these reactions, {researchers, siesta, freelance, timeserver} enlisted {visitors, exoskeleton, particular, solicitor} at an event called the North Carolina BugFest. One - hundred - forty - three volunteers smelled smushed ants and were asked to identify the scent from four choices: blue cheese, rancid butter, rotten coconut or just other. Although Web sites overwhelmingly call the smell rotten coconut, almost 40 percent of the human judges picked blue cheese and about 25 percent picked rotten coconut. More than 30 percent went with the choice of other. The scientists then analyzed the chemicals {responsible, watchable, volatile, cantonal} for the ant odor, as well as the smelly chemicals in blue cheese, fresh coconut and coconut buried underground for three days. It turns out that the chemistry of the ants' scent is indeed similar to that of blue cheese and rotten coconut. But not to fresh coconut. And the researchers note that the Penicillium {microbes, diode, thighbone, firestorm} that turn coconut oil rancid are also {involved, excluded, isolated, omitted} in the production of blue cheese. The study is in the journal American Entomologist. The researchers also noted that the most common write - in candidate as a description for the ants' aroma was 'cleaning spray.' And one little girl told them that the ants 'smelled exactly like her doctor.'
questions.contentTranslation: 看到家里有蚂蚁，常见的反应是踩死它。但如果你压碎一种名为Tapinoma sessile的蚂蚁，你可能会闻到一股奇怪的气味——这种气味让一些人联想到蓝奶酪、腐臭的黄油或烂椰子。事实上，这种气味如此明显，以至于这种昆虫的俗名是‘臭味家蚁’。很多人称之为椰子蚁。为了弄清人们为何有这些反应，研究人员在名为北卡罗来纳虫节的活动中招募了访客。一百四十三名志愿者闻了被压碎的蚂蚁，并被要求从四个选项中识别气味：蓝奶酪、腐臭黄油、烂椰子或其他。尽管网站上绝大多数称这种气味为烂椰子，但近40%的人类评判者选择了蓝奶酪，约25%选择了烂椰子，超过30%选择了其他。科学家们随后分析了负责蚂蚁气味的化学物质，以及蓝奶酪、新鲜椰子和埋在地下的三天椰子中的气味化学物质。结果表明，蚂蚁气味的化学成分确实与蓝奶酪和烂椰子相似，但与新鲜椰子不同。研究人员指出，使椰子油变质的青霉菌也参与了蓝奶酪的生产。这项研究发表在《美国昆虫学家》期刊上。研究人员还指出，作为蚂蚁气味描述的最常见自填选项是‘清洁喷雾’。一个小姐姐告诉他们，蚂蚁‘闻起来和她的医生一模一样’。

blanks.explanation: 选择'researchers'是因为‘研究人员’调查反应，符合科学背景。
选择'visitors'是因为在活动中招募‘访客’，表示参与者。
选择'responsible'是因为化学物质‘负责’气味，表示原因。
选择'microbes'是因为‘微生物’使油变质，与生物过程相关。
选择'involved'是因为微生物‘参与’蓝奶酪生产，表示作用。

questions.title: Information Revolution
questions.content: Some have begun to call it the Information Revolution. Technological changes brought dramatic new {challenges,puZZles,options,confusion} to Americans living in the 1990s. From the beginning of the decade until the end, new forms of entertainment, commerce, research, work, and communication became commonplace in the United States. The {unremitting,uninspiring,driving,insinuating} force behind much of this change was an innovation popularly known as the Internet. Personal computers had become widespread by the end of the 1980s. Through a device called a modem, individual users could link their computer to a {magnitude,bulk,wealth,volume} of information using conventional phone lines. What lay beyond the individual computer was a vast domain of information known as cyberspace. Upon its {relief,release,publication,emission} in 1983 the Apple 'Lisa' computer was supposed to revolutionize personal computing. But interest in 'Lisa' was minimal due to its nearly $10,000 price tag and the introduction of the much more {convenient,affordable,advanced,formidable} 'Macintosh' a year later.
questions.contentTranslation: 一些人开始称之为信息革命。技术变革为1990年代生活的美国人带来了戏剧性的新选择。从十年初到末，新形式的娱乐、商业、研究、工作和通信在美国变得司空见惯。这场变革背后的驱动力是一项广为人知的创新——互联网。到1980年代末，个人电脑已广泛普及。通过一种称为调制解调器的设备，个人用户可以使用常规电话线将他们的计算机连接到大量信息中。个人电脑之外是一个被称为网络空间的广阔信息领域。苹果‘Lisa’计算机在1983年发布时，本应革命化个人计算。但由于其近10,000美元的价格标签和一年后推出的更实惠的‘Macintosh’，人们对‘Lisa’的兴趣微乎其微。

blanks.explanation: 选择'options'是因为技术变革带来新‘选择’，如娱乐等，符合正面描述。
选择'driving'是因为互联网是变革的‘驱动力’，表示推动作用。
选择'wealth'是因为连接到‘大量’信息，表示丰富性，符合语境。
选择'release'是因为‘Lisa’在1983年‘发布’，表示推出产品。
选择'affordable'是因为‘Macintosh’更‘实惠’，与高价‘Lisa’对比。

questions.title: Defining a Country
questions.content: What is a country, and how is a country defined? When people ask how many countries there are in the world, they expect a simple answer. After all, we've explored the {whole, very, only, total} planet, we have international travel, satellite navigation and plenty of global organizations like the United Nations, {so, but, and, or} we should really know how many countries there are! However, the answer to the question varies according to whom you ask. {Most, Few, All, Least} people say there are 192 countries, but others point out that there could be more like 260 of them. So why isn't there a straightforward answer? The problem arises because there isn't a universally agreed definition of 'country' and because, for political reasons, some countries find it convenient to recognize or not recognize {other, those, their, all} countries.
questions.contentTranslation: 什么是国家，国家如何定义？当人们询问世界上有多少国家时，他们期待一个简单答案。毕竟，我们已经探索了整个地球，我们有国际旅行、卫星导航和许多像联合国这样的全球组织，所以我们应该真正知道有多少国家！然而，这个问题的答案因人而异。大多数人说有192个国家，但其他人指出可能多达260个。那么为什么没有一个直接的答案呢？问题出现是因为没有一个普遍认同的‘国家’定义，而且由于政治原因，一些国家认为承认或不承认其他国家是方便的。

blanks.explanation: 选择'whole'是因为探索了‘整个’地球，表示全面性。
选择'so'是因为‘所以’我们应该知道，表示因果逻辑。
选择'Most'是因为‘大多数’人说192个，表示普遍看法。
选择'other'是因为承认‘其他’国家，表示非本国。

questions.title: United Nations
questions.content: Founded after World War II by 51 'peace - loving states' combined to oppose future aggression, the United Nations now counts 192 member nations, {including, consists, includes} its newest members, Nauru, Kiribati, and Tonga in 1999, Tuvalu and Yugoslavia in 2000, Switzerland and East Timor in 2002, and Montenegro in 2006. United Nations Day has been {observed, selected, selecting, observing} on October 24 since 1948 and celebrates the objectives and accomplishments of the organization, which was established on October 24, 1945. The UN {engages, picks, observes, maintains} in peacekeeping and humanitarian missions across the globe. Though some say its {influence, immediacy, emergence, affect} has declined in recent decades, the United Nations still plays a {tremendous, suspicious, rancorous, despicable} role in world politics. In 2001 the United Nations and Kofi Annan, then Secretary - General of the UN, won the Nobel Peace Prize 'for their work for a better organized and more peaceful world.' Since 1948 there have been 63 UN peacekeeping {operations, manipulations, abstinences, forbearances} ; 16 are currently underway.
questions.contentTranslation: 联合国在二战后由51个‘爱好和平的国家’联合创立，以反对未来的侵略，如今拥有192个成员国，包括其最新成员：1999年的瑙鲁、基里巴斯和汤加，2000年的图瓦卢和南斯拉夫，2002年的瑞士和东帝汶，以及2006年的黑山。自1948年以来，联合国日于10月24日被纪念，庆祝该组织的目标和成就，该组织成立于1945年10月24日。联合国在全球参与维和与人道主义任务。尽管有人说其影响力近几十年来有所下降，联合国仍在世界政治中扮演着巨大的角色。2001年，联合国及其时任秘书长科菲\xb7安南因‘为一个更有组织、更和平的世界所做的工作’而获得诺贝尔和平奖。自1948年以来，已有63次联合国维和行动；目前有16次正在进行。

blanks.explanation: 选择'including'是因为‘包括’新成员，表示列举，符合语境。
选择'observed'是因为联合国日被‘纪念’，表示传统行为。
选择'engages'是因为联合国‘参与’任务，表示主动行动。
选择'influence'是因为有人说其‘影响力’下降，符合政治语境。
选择'tremendous'是因为联合国角色‘巨大’，表示重要性。
选择'operations'是因为指维和‘行动’，符合联合国任务。

questions.title: Exercise and Modern Life
questions.content: One thing is certain. Most people do not get enough exercise in their {daily, simple, common, usual} routines. All of the advances of modern technology — from {vibrational, electronic, synthetic, electric} can openers to power steering have made life easier, more comfortable and much less physically {need, demanding, pushing, supplying}. Yet our bodies need activities, especially if they are carrying around too {few, many, much, several} fat. Satisfying this need requires a sustainable plan, and a commitment. There are two {opposite, odd, main, fair} ways to increase the number of calories you spend: start a regular exercise program if you do not have one already. Increase the amount of physical activity in your daily routine.
questions.contentTranslation: 有一件事是肯定的。大多数人在他们的日常生活中没有得到足够的锻炼。现代技术的所有进步——从电动开罐器到动力转向——使生活更轻松、更舒适，身体需求大大减少。然而，我们的身体需要活动，特别是如果它们承载了过多的脂肪。满足这一需求需要一个可持续的计划和承诺。有两种主要方法可以增加你消耗的卡路里：如果你还没有常规锻炼计划，就开始一个。增加日常生活中体育活动的量。

blanks.explanation: 选择'daily'是因为它指‘日常’生活，与'routines'搭配自然，表示经常性。
选择'electric'是因为‘电动’设备（如开罐器和动力转向）是技术进步的典型例子，符合语境。
选择'demanding'是因为技术使生活对身体‘要求’减少，表示体力需求的下降。
选择'much'是因为‘过多’脂肪用不可数形式，与'fat'的量搭配正确。
选择'main'是因为这里列举‘主要’方法，强调核心解决方案。

questions.title: Sales and Customer Orientation
questions.content: Organizations need to integrate their sales activities more both internally and with customers' needs according to a new book co - authored by an academic at the University of East Anglia. The book {addresses, stipulates, predicts, writes} how sales can help organizations to become more customer - oriented and considers how they are responding to challenges such as increasing competition, more {demanding, friendly, needy, aggressive} customers and a more complex selling environment. Many organizations are facing escalating costs and a growth in customer power, {which, this, that, where} makes it necessary to allocate resources more strategically. However, the authors say that within the industry {there, which, that, it} is still uncertainty about the shape a future sales team should take, how it should be managed, and how it {fits, apply into, develop into, suit} into their organization's business model.
questions.contentTranslation: 根据东英吉利大学一位学者合著的新书，组织需要将其销售活动在内部以及与客户需求之间更好地整合。该书讨论了销售如何帮助组织变得更加以客户为中心，并考虑了它们如何应对日益激烈的竞争、更苛刻的客户和更复杂的销售环境等挑战。许多组织面临成本上升和客户权力增长，这使得更有策略地分配资源变得必要。然而，作者表示，在行业内仍然存在关于未来销售团队应采取何种形式、如何管理以及它如何融入组织商业模式的不确定性。

blanks.explanation: 选择'addresses'是因为书‘讨论’销售如何帮助组织，表示处理或涉及某个主题。
选择'demanding'是因为客户变得更‘苛刻’，符合竞争和复杂环境的语境。
选择'which'是因为它作为关系代词引导非限制性定语从句，修饰前面的情况。
选择'there'是因为‘there is’表示行业内‘存在’不确定性，符合句式。
选择'fits'是因为销售团队需‘适应’商业模式，表示匹配。

questions.title: Herbals and Medicinal Plants
questions.content: A herbal is a book of plants, describing their appearance, their properties and how they may be used for preparing ointments and medicines. The medical use of plants is {recorded, registered, memorized, discovered} on fragments of papyrus and clay tablets from ancient Egypt, Samaria and China that date back 5,000 years but document traditions far older still. Over 700 herbal remedies were detailed in the Papyrus Ebers, an Egyptian text written in 1500 BC. Around 65 BC, a Greek physician called Dioscorides wrote a herbal that was {translated, moved, interpreted, removed} into Latin and Arabic. Known as 'De materia medica', it became the most influential work on medicinal plants in both Christian and Islamic worlds until the late 17th century. An illustrated manuscript copy of the text made in Constantinople (modern - day Istanbul) {survives, preserves, revives, suffers} from the sixth century. The first printed herbals date from the dawn of European printing in the 1480s. They provided valuable information for apothecaries, whose job was to make the pills and potions {prescribed, presided, presented, predominated} by physicians. In the next century, landmark herbals were produced in England by William Turner, considered to be the father of British botany, and John Gerard, whose illustrations would inspire the floral fabric, wallpaper and tile designs of William Morris four centuries later.
questions.contentTranslation: 草药书是一本关于植物的书，描述它们的外观、特性以及如何用于制备药膏和药物。植物的医疗用途被记录在来自古埃及、撒玛利亚和中国的莎草纸碎片和泥板上，这些记录可追溯到5000年前，但记载的传统更为古老。超过700种草药疗法在公元前1500年写的埃及文本《埃伯斯纸莎草书》中被详细描述。公元前65年左右，一位名叫迪奥斯科里德的希腊医生撰写了一本草药书，这本书被翻译成拉丁文和阿拉伯文。被称为《药物论》的这部作品成为基督教和伊斯兰世界中最具影响力的药用植物著作，直到17世纪末。君士坦丁堡（现代伊斯坦布尔）制作的插图手稿副本从6世纪保存至今。第一批印刷草药书出现在1480年代欧洲印刷术的黎明时期。它们为药剂师提供了宝贵信息，药剂师的工作是制作医生开具的药丸和药剂。下一个世纪，英国的威廉\xb7特纳（被认为是英国植物学之父）和约翰\xb7杰拉德制作了里程碑式的草药书，杰拉德的插图在四个世纪后启发了威廉\xb7莫里斯的花卉织物、壁纸和瓷砖设计。

blanks.explanation: 选择'recorded'是因为植物用途被‘记录’在古文献中，表示书面记载。
选择'translated'是因为草药书被‘翻译’成其他语言，表示语言转换。
选择'survives'是因为手稿‘保存至今’，表示仍然存在。
选择'prescribed'是因为药剂师制作医生‘开具’的药物，表示处方。

questions.title: Tutankhamun's Mummy
questions.content: The last tourists may have been leaving the Valley of the Kings on the West Bank in Luxor but the area in front of the tomb of Tutankhamun remained far from deserted. Instead of the {tranquility, chaos, permanence, ecstasy, franchise} that usually descends on the area in the evening it was a hive of activity. TV crews trailed masses of equipment, journalists milled and photographers held their cameras at the ready. The reason? For the first time since Howard Carter {discovered, showed, founded, dismantled, accounted} the tomb in 1922 the mummy of Tutankhamun was being prepared for public display. Inside the subterranean burial chamber Egypt's archaeology supremo Zahi Hawass, {accompanied, accomplished, complimented, affected, afflicted} by four Egyptologists, two restorers and three workmen, were slowly lifting the mummy from the golden sarcophagus where it has {rested, commuted, transmitted, convoyed, conflated} -- mostly undisturbed -- for more than 3,000 years. The body was then placed on a wooden stretcher and {transported, commuted, transmitted, convoyed, conflated} to its new home, a high- tech, climate-controlled plexi-glass showcase located in the outer chamber of the tomb where, covered in linen, with only the face and feet exposed, it now greets visitors.
questions.contentTranslation: 最后的游客可能已经离开卢克索西岸的国王谷，但图坦卡蒙墓前的区域远非空无一人。通常在傍晚降临这片区域的宁静被一片忙碌所取代。电视摄制组拖着大量设备，记者们四处走动，摄影师们手持相机待命。原因何在？自从霍华德\xb7卡特1922年发现这座墓以来，图坦卡蒙的木乃伊首次被准备公开展示。在地下墓室中，埃及考古学权威扎希\xb7哈瓦斯，伴随着四位埃及学家、两位修复师和三位工人，慢慢地将木乃伊从金色石棺中抬起，这具木乃伊在那里安息了——几乎未被打扰——超过3000年。然后，尸体被放置在一个木制担架上，并被运送到它的新家，一个位于墓外室的高科技、气候控制的有机玻璃展示柜中，覆盖着亚麻布，仅露出面部和脚部，现在它在那里迎接访客。

blanks.explanation: 选择'tranquility'是因为傍晚通常带来‘宁静’，与忙碌形成对比。
选择'discovered'是因为卡特‘发现’了墓，符合考古历史。
选择'accompanied'是因为哈瓦斯‘伴随着’团队，表示一起行动。
选择'rested'是因为木乃伊在石棺中‘安息’，表示静止状态。
选择'transported'是因为尸体被‘运送’到新位置，表示移动。

questions.title: Film Production
questions.content: Film is where art meets commerce. {As, Likely, Unlike, Despite} Orson Welles said:'A painter just needs a brush and the writer just needs a pen, but the producer needs an army.' And an army needs money. A producer is just like an entrepreneur, and we {raise, arise, rise, raze} money to make films. First, we need to find an original idea or a book or a play and purchase the rights, then we need money to develop that idea, often not a reasonably small sum. {Besides, Or, Nevertheless, Thus} , to commission a writer for the screenplay isn't something you would want to gamble your own money on, so you find a partner. We are lucky here in the UK, as we have Film 4, BBC Films and the UK Film Council, all of {which, that, them, those} are good places to develop an idea. Producing in Britain is very different to producing in America or {even, until, unless, ever} Europe because the economic dynamic is different.
questions.contentTranslation: 电影是艺术与商业的交汇处。正如奥森\xb7威尔斯所说：‘画家只需要一支画笔，作家只需要一支笔，但制片人需要一支军队。’而一支军队需要资金。制片人就像企业家，我们筹集资金来制作电影。首先，我们需要找到一个原创想法或一本书或戏剧并购买版权，然后我们需要资金来开发这个想法，通常不是一笔小数目。此外，委托一个编剧写剧本不是你愿意拿自己的钱去冒险的事情，所以你会找一个合作伙伴。我们在英国很幸运，因为我们有Film 4、BBC Films和英国电影委员会，这些都是开发想法的好地方。在英国制片与在美国或甚至欧洲制片非常不同，因为经济动态不同。

blanks.explanation: 选择'As'是因为它引导引用威尔斯的话，表示‘正如’。
选择'raise'是因为制片人‘筹集’资金，表示主动行为。
选择'Besides'是因为它表示‘此外’，补充说明额外情况。
选择'which'是因为它引导非限制性定语从句，修饰前面机构。
选择'even'是因为它表示‘甚至’欧洲也不同，加强对比。

questions.title: Language and Communication
questions.content: Language comes so naturally to us that it is easy to forget what a strange and miraculous gift it is. All over the world members of our {species, humanity, people, group} fashion their breath into hisses and hums and squeaks and pops and listen to others do the {same, so, liking, similarity}. We do this, of course, not only because we like the sounds but because details of the sounds contain information about the {intentions, activities, relationships, sounds} of the person making them. We, humans, are fitted with a means of {sharing, rendering, loading, turning} our ideas, in all their unfathomable vastness. When we listen to speech, we can be led to think thoughts that have never been thought before and that never would have {occurred, appeared , risen , thought} to us on our own.
questions.contentTranslation: 语言对我们来说如此自然，以至于我们很容易忘记它是多么奇特而神奇的礼物。全世界我们的物种成员将他们的呼吸塑造成嘶嘶声、嗡嗡声、吱吱声和爆破声，并倾听他人做同样的事情。当然，我们这样做不仅仅因为我们喜欢这些声音，而是因为声音的细节包含了发出它们的人的意图信息。我们人类拥有一种分享我们思想的方式，这些思想深不可测。当我们聆听语言时，我们可以被引导去思考以前从未想过的想法，这些想法如果靠我们自己永远不会浮现。

blanks.explanation: 选择'species'是因为它指‘物种’，强调人类作为生物整体。
选择'same'是因为他人做‘同样’的事情，与前文一致。
选择'intentions'是因为声音包含发出者的‘意图’，符合语义。
选择'sharing'是因为人类通过语言‘分享’思想，表示交流。
选择'occurred'是因为想法不会‘浮现’在我们脑海，符合表达‘occur to sb.’。

questions.title: Distance Learning Benefits
questions.content: Distance learning can be highly beneficial to a large variety of people from young students wanting to expand their horizons to adults looking for more job security. With programs that allow learners of all ages to take courses for fun, personal advancement and {degrees, confirmations, discriminations, abhorrences} , distance learning can {meet, achieve, devise, claim} the needs of a diverse population. Perhaps one of the most notable and often talked about {advantages, definitions, factors, defaults} of distance learning is the flexibility. The majority of programs allow students to learn when and where it's convenient for them. For {those, they, them, that} who are struggling to balance their distance learning goals with working a full - time job and taking care of a family this kind of flexibility can allow many people to {pursue, obey, test, accelerate} education who would not otherwise be able to do so. {Since, Besides, Despite, Due to} there are no on - campus courses to attend, students can learn from their own homes, at work on their lunch breaks and from virtually anywhere with internet access. For some it can even be a big source of savings on the fuel costs and time required to commute to classes.
questions.contentTranslation: 远程学习对各种人群都非常有益，从希望拓宽视野的年轻学生到寻求更多工作保障的成年人。有了允许所有年龄段学习者为了娱乐、个人提升和学位而参加课程的计划，远程学习可以满足不同人群的需求。也许远程学习最显著且经常被讨论的优势之一是灵活性。大多数项目允许学生在他们方便的时间和地点学习。对于那些努力平衡远程学习目标、全职工作和照顾家庭的人来说，这种灵活性可以让许多原本无法接受教育的人追求教育。由于没有需要参加的校园课程，学生可以从家里、在工作午休时间学习，或者几乎在任何有互联网接入的地方学习。对一些人来说，这甚至可以大大节省通勤上课所需的燃料成本和时间。

blanks.explanation: 选择'degrees'是因为学习者追求‘学位’，符合教育目标。
选择'meet'是因为远程学习‘满足’需求，表示适应性。
选择'advantages'是因为灵活性是‘优势’，符合正面描述。
选择'those'是因为指代‘那些’努力平衡的人，符合语法。
选择'pursue'是因为人们‘追求’教育，表示目标。
选择'Since'是因为‘由于’没有校园课程，解释原因。

questions.title: United Nations' Work
questions.content: The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945. Due to its unique international character, and the powers vested in its founding Charter, the organization can take {action, advantage, recognition, promotion} on a wide range of issues and provide a forum for its 193 Member States to {express, reveal, release, contradict} their views , through the General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council and other bodies and committees. The work of the United Nations reaches every {corner, war, meeting, time} of the globe. Although best known for peacekeeping, peacebuilding, conflict {prevention, prediction, renovation, invention} and humanitarian assistance, there are many other ways the United Nations and its System (specialized agencies, funds and programs) affect our lives and make the world a better place.
questions.contentTranslation: 联合国是一个成立于1945年的国际组织。由于其独特的国际性质和其创始宪章赋予的权力，该组织可以在广泛的问题上采取行动，并为其193个会员国提供一个表达意见的论坛，通过大会、安全理事会、经济及社会理事会以及其他机构和委员会。联合国的工作遍及全球的每一个角落。虽然最以维和、和平建设和冲突预防以及人道主义援助而闻名，但联合国及其系统（专门机构、基金和项目）还有许多其他方式影响我们的生活并使世界变得更美好。

blanks.explanation: 选择'action'是因为联合国‘采取行动’，表示实际措施。
选择'express'是因为会员国‘表达’观点，符合论坛功能。
选择'corner'是因为工作遍及全球‘每个角落’，表示广泛覆盖。
选择'prevention'是因为联合国致力于‘预防’冲突，符合使命。

questions.title: Exercise and Chronic Diseases
questions.content: If you have a {chronic, acute, rarely, abnormal} disease such as heart disease, diabetes, asthma, or back or joint pain, exercise can have important health {issues, rituals, problems, benefits}. However, it's important to talk to your doctor before starting an exercise {operation, habit, outfit, routine}. He or she might have {advice, compliment, addiction, advertisement} on what exercises are safe and any precautions you might need to take while exercising.
questions.contentTranslation: 如果你患有慢性疾病，如心脏病、糖尿病、哮喘或背部或关节疼痛，锻炼可以带来重要的健康益处。然而，在开始锻炼计划之前，与你的医生交谈很重要。他或她可能会就哪些锻炼是安全的以及你在锻炼时可能需要采取的任何预防措施提供建议。

blanks.explanation: 选择'chronic'是因为列举的疾病是‘慢性’的，持续时间长。
选择'benefits'是因为锻炼带来‘益处’，符合正面效果。
选择'routine'是因为指锻炼‘计划’，表示常规安排。
选择'advice'是因为医生提供‘建议’，符合医疗语境。

questions.title: Plants and Human Challenges
questions.content: Plants serve as the conduit of energy into the biosphere, provide food and materials used by humans, and they {shape, overarch, disembark, constitute} our environment. According to Ehrhardt and Frommer, the three major challenges facing humanity in our time are food, energy, and environmental {demotion, discredit, declaration, degradation}. All of our food is produced by plants, either directly or indirectly via animals that eat them. Plants are a {source, cause, root, outcome} of energy production. And they are intimately involved in climate change and a major factor in a variety of environmental concerns, including agricultural expansion and its impact on habitat destruction and waterway pollution. What's more, none of these issues is independent of each other. Climate change places additional stresses on the food supply and on various habitats. So, plant research is instrumental in addressing all of these problems and moving into the future. For plant research to move significantly forward, Ehrhardt and Former say technological development is critical, both to test existing hypotheses and to gain new information and generate fresh hypotheses. If we are to make headway in understanding how these essential organisms function and build the foundation for a sustainable future, then we need to apply the most advanced technologies available to the study of plant life, they say.
questions.contentTranslation: 植物作为能量进入生物圈的管道，为人类提供食物和材料，并塑造我们的环境。据Ehrhardt和Frommer称，我们这个时代人类面临的三大挑战是食物、能源和环境退化。我们所有的食物都由植物生产，直接或通过吃植物的动物间接产生。植物是能源生产的一个来源。它们与气候变化密切相关，是多种环境问题的主要因素，包括农业扩张及其对栖息地破坏和水道污染的影响。更重要的是，这些问题彼此并非独立的。气候变化给食物供应和各种栖息地带来了额外的压力。因此，植物研究在解决所有这些问题并走向未来方面起着关键作用。为了让植物研究取得显著进展，Ehrhardt和Former表示技术发展至关重要，既用于测试现有假设，也用于获取新信息并生成新的假设。如果我们要在理解这些重要生物如何运作并为可持续未来奠定基础方面取得进展，那么我们需要将最先进的技术应用于植物生命研究，他们说。

blanks.explanation: 选择'shape'是因为植物‘塑造’环境，表示影响和形成。
选择'degradation'是因为环境‘退化’是挑战，符合语境。
选择'source'是因为植物是能源的‘来源’，表示起源。

questions.title: Story Titles
questions.content: A good story may be given a bad title by its author, and so started toward failure. Novices are peculiarly {liable, able, responsible, possible} to this fault, usually through {allowed, allows, allow, allowing} themselves to too easily satisfied. They go to {infinite, stagnant, faint, disastrous} pains to make the story itself fresh and individual, and then cap it with a {commonplace, perplexing, invisible, distinctive} phrase that is worse than no title at all. A good title is apt, specific, attractive, new, and short. A title is apt if it is an outgrowth of the plot — a text, as I have said. It stands definitely for that particular story, and gives a suggestion of what is to come — but only a suggestion, lest it should anticipate the denouement and so {satisfy, confuse, encourage, stimulate} the curiosity of the reader too soon.
questions.contentTranslation: 一个好故事可能会因为作者给它取了一个坏标题而走向失败。新手尤其容易犯这个错误，通常是因为他们让自己太容易满足。他们费尽心思使故事本身新颖独特，然后却用一个平庸的短语作为标题，这比没有标题还要糟。一个好的标题应当贴切、具体、有吸引力、新颖且简短。如果标题是情节的自然延伸——正如我所说，它就贴切。它明确代表那个特定的故事，并给出即将发生什么的暗示——但只是暗示，以免提前揭示结局，从而过早满足读者的好奇心。

blanks.explanation: 选择'liable'是因为新手‘容易’犯错，符合表达‘be liable to’。
选择'allowing'是因为‘允许’自己太满足，表示行为原因。
选择'infinite'是因为他们付出‘无穷’努力，强调程度。
选择'commonplace'是因为‘平庸’标题与好故事不符，符合批评。
选择'satisfy'是因为标题不应‘满足’好奇心，保持悬念。

questions.title: Fresh Water Supply
questions.content: Everybody needs fresh water. {Despite, As, With, Without} water, people, animals and plants cannot live. Although a few plants and animals can make do with saltwater, all humans need a constant supply of fresh water if they are to stay {excited, fit, here, up} and healthy. Of the total supply of water on the Earth, only about 3 percent of it is fresh, and most of that is stored as ice and snow at the poles, or is so {wide, hard, deep, common} under the surface of the Earth that we cannot get to it. Despite so much of the water being out of reach, we still have a million cubic miles of it that we {won't, don't, cannot, can} use. That's about 4,300,000 cubic kilometers of fresh water to share out between most of the plants, animals and people on the planet.
questions.contentTranslation: 每个人都需要淡水。没有水，人、动物和植物无法生存。虽然少数植物和动物可以依靠咸水生存，但所有人类都需要持续的淡水供应才能保持健康。地球上总水量中只有约3%是淡水，其中大部分以冰雪形式储存在极地，或者深埋在地球表面之下，我们无法获取。尽管如此多的水遥不可及，我们仍然有100万立方英里的淡水可以使用。这大约是430万立方公里的淡水，供地球上大多数植物、动物和人类分享。

blanks.explanation: 选择'Without'是因为‘没有’水无法生存，表示必要条件。
选择'fit'是因为淡水让人保持‘健康’，与'healthy'搭配。
选择'deep'是因为水‘深埋’地下，表示位置难以获取。
选择'can'是因为我们‘可以’使用这些水，表示可能性。

questions.title: Dance in Musicals
questions.content: Dance has played an important role in many musicals. In some {brief, extent, times, cases} , dance numbers are included as an excuse to add to the color and spectacle of the show, but dance is more effective when it forms an integral part of the {prowess, plot, phenomenon, roundabout} . An early example is Richard Rodgers On Your Toes(1936) in which the story about classical ballet meeting the world of jazz enabled dance to be introduced in a way that {encumbers, enhances, levels, crumples} , rather than interrupts the drama.
questions.contentTranslation: 舞蹈在许多音乐剧中扮演了重要角色。在某些情况下，舞蹈部分被加入只是为了增加节目的色彩和壮观，但当舞蹈成为情节的有机组成部分时，它更有效。早期的例子是理查德\xb7罗杰斯的《On Your Toes》（1936），其中关于古典芭蕾与爵士乐世界相遇的故事使舞蹈得以引入，以一种增强而非打断戏剧的方式。

blanks.explanation: 选择'cases'是因为指‘某些情况’，符合语境中的特定例子。
选择'plot'是因为舞蹈应融入‘情节’，表示故事核心。
选择'enhances'是因为舞蹈‘增强’戏剧效果，表示提升。

questions.title: Coral Reefs
questions.content: Coral reefs {curb, harvest, support, cultivate} more marine life than any other ocean ecosystem and are, not {seemingly, surprisingly, specially, demandingly} , a favorite pursuit for many divers. But as well as being physically and biologically spectacular, coral reefs also sustain the livelihoods of over half a billion people. What is more, this number is expected to {appear, double, countdown, unravel} in coming decades while the area of high - quality reef is expected to halve. In combination with the very real threat of climate change, which could lead to increased seawater temperatures and ocean acidification , we start to arrive at some quite frightening scenarios.
questions.contentTranslation: 珊瑚礁支持的海洋生物比任何其他海洋生态系统都多，并且毫不意外地，是许多潜水者的最爱。但除了在物理和生物上壮观外，珊瑚礁还维持着超过五亿人的生计。更重要的是，这个数字预计在未来几十年内将翻倍，而高质量珊瑚礁的面积预计将减半。结合气候变化的真实威胁——可能导致海水温度升高和海洋酸化，我们开始面临一些相当可怕的情景。

blanks.explanation: 选择'support'是因为珊瑚礁‘支持’海洋生物，表示维持。
选择'surprisingly'是因为‘毫不意外’符合逻辑，否定后表示预期。
选择'double'是因为人数预计‘翻倍’，符合数量增长。

questions.title: International Trade
questions.content: International trade allows countries to expand their markets and access goods and services that {either, otherwise, thus, neither} may not have been available domestically. As a {prelude, result, degree, delegation} of international trade, the market is more efficient. This ultimately leads to more competitive pricing and brings {newer, cheaper, all, novel} products to consumers.
questions.contentTranslation: 国际贸易允许各国扩展市场并获取国内原本无法获得的商品和服务。作为国际贸易的结果，市场更加高效。这最终导致更具竞争力的定价，并为消费者带来更便宜的产品。

blanks.explanation: 选择'otherwise'是因为指‘否则’无法获得的商品，表示条件。
选择'result'是因为市场效率是贸易的‘结果’，表示因果。
选择'cheaper'是因为竞争导致‘更便宜’的产品，符合逻辑。

questions.title: Digital Media
questions.content: Digital media extends beyond mere technological advancement; it has reshaped the {very, somehow, somewhat, both} fabric of social interaction and cultural expression. Social media platforms, online forums, and digital communication tools have created new spaces for community building, activism, and personal expression. The rise of digital media has given {movement, sight, development, birth} to novel cultural phenomena and has altered the landscape of how information is disseminated and consumed. Digital anthropologists and sociologists are increasingly focusing on the multifaceted impact of these platforms, employing sophisticated methodologies to understand their influence on societal dynamics. Their research {installs, examines, claims, admits} the nuanced ways in which digital media shapes public discourse, fosters community engagement, and transforms traditional cultural {practices, manuals, cores, comments} . This exploration into digital dynamics underscores the profound and continuing impact of technology on human interaction, societal structures, and cultural evolution.
questions.contentTranslation: 数字媒体不仅仅是技术进步；它重塑了社交互动和文化表达的本质结构。社交媒体平台、在线论坛和数字通信工具为社区建设、激进主义和个人表达创造了新的空间。数字媒体的兴起催生了新的文化现象，并改变了信息传播和消费的格局。数字人类学家和社会学家越来越关注这些平台的多方面影响，采用复杂的方法来理解它们对社会动态的影响。他们的研究审视了数字媒体如何以微妙的方式塑造公共话语，促进社区参与，并转变传统文化实践。对数字动态的探索凸显了技术对人类互动、社会结构和文化演变的深远且持续的影响。

blanks.explanation: 选择'very'是因为强调‘本质’结构，表示强烈程度。
选择'birth'是因为数字媒体‘催生’新现象，表示起源。
选择'examines'是因为研究‘审视’影响，表示分析。
选择'practices'是因为媒体转变‘实践’，表示文化行为。

questions.title: Sustainable Fashion
questions.content: In recent years, the fashion industry has seen a {immaculate, superficial, costly, dramatic} shift towards sustainability. This change is driven by growing {indifference, enthusiasm, disinterest, awareness} about the environmental and social impacts of fast fashion. Fast fashion, characterized by rapid production and disposal of inexpensive clothing, has led to issues like textile waste and exploitation of labor. One of the most promising {obstacles, subscription, developments, complaints} in sustainable fashion is the use of recycled materials. Brands are increasingly using recycled fabrics, such as PET bottles turned into polyester, to create stylish and eco-friendly clothing. Additionally, sustainable fashion emphasizes durable designs and encourages consumers to buy fewer, higher-quality pieces that last longer. However, the transition to sustainable fashion also poses {advantages, challenges, opportunities, benefits} . The cost of sustainable materials and ethical production practices can make clothing more expensive, which may limit accessibility. Moreover, there is a need for greater transparency and accountability in the fashion supply chain to ensure that claims of sustainability are not just marketing tactics. In conclusion, the fashion industry's shift towards sustainability is a {meaningful, controversial, temporary, irrelevant} response to pressing global challenges, but it also requires addressing affordability and transparency issues to create a lasting impact.
questions.contentTranslation: 近年来，时尚行业经历了向可持续性的显著转变。这一变化是由人们对快时尚环境和社会影响日益增长的意识驱动的。快时尚以快速生产和丢弃廉价服装为特征，导致了纺织废物和劳动力剥削等问题。可持续时尚中最有希望的发展之一是使用回收材料。品牌越来越多地使用回收面料，例如将PET瓶转化为聚酯纤维，创造出时尚且环保的服装。此外，可持续时尚强调耐用设计，并鼓励消费者购买更少但质量更高、使用寿命更长的衣物。然而，向可持续时尚的转变也带来了挑战。可持续材料和道德生产实践的成本可能使服装更昂贵，这可能限制可及性。此外，时尚供应链需要更大的透明度和问责制，以确保可持续性的声明不仅仅是营销策略。总之，时尚行业向可持续性的转变是对紧迫全球挑战的有意义的回应，但也需要解决可负担性和透明度问题，以产生持久影响。

blanks.explanation: 选择'dramatic'是因为转变是‘显著的’，表示重大变化。
选择'awareness'是因为‘意识’推动转变，表示认知提升。
选择'developments'是因为回收材料是‘发展’，表示进步。
选择'challenges'是因为转变带来‘挑战’，如成本问题。
选择'meaningful'是因为转变是‘有意义的’，应对全球问题。

questions.title: Car Engine and Air Quality
questions.content: In the UK, it is recommended that drivers should {turn off, turning off, turned off} their car engines when they expect to be stationary for more than 1 minute. To encourage drivers {to turn off, turn off, turning off, turned off} their engines while waiting at rail crossings, the Kent city council placed a permanent sign at the crossing asking drivers to 'please switch off your engine when barriers are down to help improve air quality.' {For instance, In addition, Of course, On average} , drivers had to wait between 2 and 3 minutes to cross after the barrier had gone down. However, the sign didn't seem to be convincing the {exception, unity, majority, minority} of drivers to switch off their engines. '{Since, Although, Because, Thus} ' some research suggests that signs {lonely, neither, either, alone} can change behavior, the message on this sign was designed simply to be an informational request and was not guided by any particular behavioral theory,' the researchers explain. So the research team, led by Rose Mellady of the University of East Anglia, designed an intervention study.
questions.contentTranslation: 在英国，建议司机在预计停车超过1分钟时关闭汽车引擎。为了鼓励司机在铁路交叉口等待时关闭引擎，肯特市议会放置了一个永久性标志，请求司机‘当障碍物放下时请关闭引擎，以帮助改善空气质量’。平均来说，司机在障碍物放下后需要等待2到3分钟才能通过。然而，这个标志似乎并未能说服大多数司机关闭引擎。‘尽管’一些研究表明标志本身可以改变行为，但这个标志上的信息被设计为简单的请求，并未基于特定的行为理论，研究人员解释说。因此，由东英吉利大学的Rose Mellady领导的研究团队设计了一项干预研究。

blanks.explanation: 选择'turn off'是因为建议使用动词原形，表示动作。
选择'to turn off'是因为‘鼓励’后接不定式，表示目的。
选择'On average'是因为介绍等待时间用‘平均’，符合数据描述。
选择'majority'是因为标志未说服‘大多数’司机，表示普遍性。
选择'Although'是因为‘尽管’研究表明标志有效，但这里无效，表示转折。
选择'alone'是因为标志‘本身’可以改变行为，表示单独作用。

questions.title: University Campus Quality
questions.content: The research, commissioned by HEDQF, asked 1,000 students from UK universities for their views on the quality of their university campus and sheds new light on how students make decisions as they go through the application process. When asked what the most important factors were when deciding where to study, 76% of students {referred, claimed, prescribed, ranked} campus facilities as either 'quite' or'very' important, with only 8% saying it was 'not very' or 'not at all' important in their choice. This was the fourth most important factor after course, location and reputation. Estate quality increases in importance once a student has chosen a university, with 86% of students saying that it is 'quite' or'very' important in their first year of studies. However, the importance students {deliver, attach, acquire, summon} to estates decreases to 79% for third year students. The research also highlighted how factors such as demographics, region and type of university {attached, attended, acquired, augmented} have an impact on how students view the university buildings. {Collective, Existing, Predictable, Collateral} data shows capital expenditure on estates has been the highest amongst the Russell Group universities during 2001–2011. When asked where they would invest money in their universities, the top three areas in order of {prefer, preferential, prefect, preference} were: smaller class sizes, bursaries for poorer students and new buildings and facilities. When their expenditure options were restricted to estates–only items, the repair and {ratification, annexation, benevolence, maintenance} of existing buildings came out top with 77%, which suggests that new buildings should not be at the {rating, partisan, benefit, expense} of the rest of the estate, and may even highlight the deficiencies of tired and outmoded facilities.
questions.contentTranslation: 由HEDQF委托的研究询问了英国大学1000名学生对校园质量的看法，揭示了学生在申请过程中如何做出决策的新见解。当被问及决定在哪里学习时最重要的因素是什么时，76%的学生将校园设施评为‘相当’或‘非常’重要，只有8%的学生表示这在他们的选择中‘不太’或‘完全不’重要。这是继课程、位置和声誉之后的第四重要因素。一旦学生选择了大学，地产质量的重要性增加，86%的学生表示在第一年学习中它‘相当’或‘非常’重要。然而，学生对地产重视程度在三年级时下降到79%。研究还强调了人口统计、地区和大学类型等因素如何影响学生对大学建筑的看法。现有数据显示，2001-2011年间，拉塞尔集团大学的地产资本支出最高。当被问及他们会将资金投资于大学的哪些领域时，按偏好顺序排列的前三个领域是：较小的班级规模、为贫困学生提供的助学金以及新建筑和设施。当他们的支出选项仅限于地产项目时，现有建筑的维修和维护以77%的比例位居榜首，这表明新建筑不应以牺牲其他地产为代价，甚至可能凸显老旧设施的不足。

blanks.explanation: 选择'ranked'是因为学生‘评价’设施重要性，表示排序。
选择'attach'是因为学生‘赋予’重要性，表示重视程度。
选择'attended'是因为因素‘伴随’影响，表示相关性。
选择'Existing'是因为‘现有’数据表明支出情况，符合语境。
选择'preference'是因为按‘偏好’顺序排列，表示选择倾向。
选择'maintenance'是因为建筑需要‘维护’，符合现实需求。
选择'expense'是因为不应以‘代价’牺牲其他，表示平衡。

questions.title: Durkheim's Academic Journey
questions.content: Durkheim found humanistic studies uninteresting, {moving his position, alternating his mind, juggling his job, turning his attention} from psychology and philosophy to ethics and eventually, sociology. He graduated with a degree in philosophy in 1882. Durkheim's views {hasn't got, were getting, can't get, could not get} him a major academic appointment in Paris, so from 1882 to 1887 he taught philosophy at several provincial schools. In 1885 he {wrote about, ran across, came after, left for} Germany, where he studied sociology for two years. Durkheim's period in Germany {flick through, be down to, stand by, resulted in} the publication of numerous articles on German social science and philosophy, which {remained modest, gained appreciation, gained recognition, collected money} in France, earning him a teaching appointment at the University of Bordeaux in 1887.
questions.contentTranslation: 涂尔干发现人文研究无趣，将注意力从心理学和哲学转向伦理学，最终转向社会学。他于1882年获得哲学学位。涂尔干的观点无法为他在巴黎赢得一个重要的学术职位，因此从1882年到1887年，他在几所省级学校教授哲学。1885年，他前往德国，在那里学习了两年社会学。涂尔干在德国的时期促成了关于德国社会科学和哲学的众多文章发表，这些文章在法国获得了认可，为他赢得了1887年在波尔多大学的教学任命。

blanks.explanation: 选择'turning his attention'是因为涂尔干‘将注意力转向’不同领域，表示兴趣转移。
选择'could not get'是因为过去时表示他的观点‘无法’获得职位，符合历史语境。
选择'left for'是因为他‘前往’德国，表示物理移动。
选择'resulted in'是因为在德国的经历‘促成’文章发表，表示因果。
选择'gained recognition'是因为文章‘获得认可’，导致教学职位。

questions.title: Changes for New B.C. Residents
questions.content: New B.C. residents will only be required to provide their driver licence history — proof of insurance is no longer required. However, their premiums will be adjusted for the first three years {of} driving in B.C. {due to} the increased risks associated with driving in a new area. Each year you remain crash-free, your discount increases. ICBC {will credit} you with up to 15 years of driving experience (up from eight years) upon receipt of a driver's abstract {showing} the original date that you received your licence. When obtaining your B.C. licence, you can provide your original driver's abstract in person at a driver licensing office.
questions.contentTranslation: 新不列颠哥伦比亚省居民只需提供他们的驾驶执照历史记录——不再需要保险证明。然而，他们在不列颠哥伦比亚省头三年的驾驶保险费用将由于在新地区驾驶的增加风险而进行调整。每年你保持无事故记录，你的折扣就会增加。ICBC将在收到显示你首次获得驾照日期的驾驶摘要后，为你记入最多15年的驾驶经验（从之前的8年增加）。在获取不列颠哥伦比亚省驾照时，你可以亲自在驾驶执照办公室提供你的原始驾驶摘要。

blanks.explanation: 选择'of'是因为‘头三年’用‘of’表示所属关系，符合语法。
选择'due to'是因为‘由于’风险调整费用，正式且符合语境。
选择'will credit'是因为ICBC‘将记入’经验，表示将来动作。
选择'showing'是因为摘要‘显示’日期，自然且常用。

questions.title: Sandra Lousada Exhibition
questions.content: London's National Portrait Gallery is currently celebrating the fifty-year {career} of photographer Sandra Lousada. The twenty one portraits on display depict key {figures} in literature, film and fashion from the early 1960s. Subsequent to the acquisition of forty portraits by Lousada, the display at The National Portrait Gallery highlights shots taken between 1960 and 1964, many of which feature in Lousada's book Public Faces Private Places (2008). Formal commissioned portraits are shown alongside behind-the-scenes photographs taken on {sets} and unguarded portraits of sitters captured at home.
questions.contentTranslation: 伦敦国家肖像画廊目前正在庆祝摄影师桑德拉\xb7卢萨达五十年的职业生涯。展出的二十一幅肖像描绘了1960年代早期文学、电影和时尚领域的关键人物。在卢萨达的四十幅肖像被收购后，国家肖像画廊的展览突出了1960年至1964年间拍摄的照片，其中许多出现在卢萨达的书《公共面孔私人场所》（2008年）中。正式委托的肖像与在片场拍摄的幕后照片以及家中捕捉的毫无防备的肖像一同展出。

blanks.explanation: 选择'career'是因为庆祝的是她五十年的‘职业生涯’，符合主题。
选择'figures'是因为肖像描绘‘人物’，符合展览内容。
选择'sets'是因为照片在‘片场’拍摄，表示拍摄场景。

questions.title: Job Interview Opportunity
questions.content: You are very happy to be {to be considered} by the company for a position. You have {confidence} that you can leave a good {impression} on the company. In the past, you were {responsible for} certain tasks in your previous job as an XXX. Finally, you got the {opportunity} to have an in-person interview.

questions.title: Yellow
questions.content: Yellow is considered as the most optimistic color. Yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms and babies cry more in them. The reason may be that yellow is the hardest color for eyes to take in. So it can be overpowering if overused.

questions.title: Mammal
questions.content: The elephant is the largest living land mammal. During evolution, its skeleton has greatly altered from the usual mammal, designed for two main reasons. One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk, making the skull particularly massive. The other is to support the enormous bulk of such a huge body.

questions.title: Market research
questions.content: Market research is a vital part of the planning of any business. However experienced you or your staff may be in a particular field, if you are thinking of introducing a service to a new area, it is important to find out what the local population thinks about it first.

questions.title: Teenage Girls
questions.content: Teenage girls are continuing to outperform boys in English while the gender gap in achievements in math and science has almost disappeared. The figures show that last year 80% of 14-year-old girls reached at least the expected level 5 in English, compared with 65% of boys. But in math, the girls are just 1% ahead of boys, while in science the difference is 2%.

questions.title: Fast food
questions.content: Hundreds of millions of American people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought, unaware of the subtle and not so subtle ramifications of their purchases. They just grab their tray off the counter, find a table, take a seat, unwrap the paper, and dig in. The whole experience is transitory and soon forgotten.

questions.title: Enough fluid
questions.content: Your body is nearly two-thirds water. And so it is really important that you consume enough fluid to stay hydrated and healthy. If you don't get enough fluid you may feel tired, get headaches, and not perform at your best.

questions.title: Soft drinks industry
questions.content: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry had different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that they may have been biased by the research itself. The whole point of the scientific methods is to ensure the research results are not influenced by the source of funding.

questions.title: Neighbor
questions.content: Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street. Then, one morning, you open the front door and discover houses all around you. You see neighbors tending their gardens and children walking to school. Where did all the people come from? What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there, you just hadn't seen them.

questions.title: Yellow (Alternative)
questions.content: Cheerful sunny yellow is an attention getter. While it is considered an optimistic color, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more. It is the most difficult color for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused. Yellow enhances concentration, hence its use for legal pads. It also speeds metabolism.

questions.title: History is selective
questions.content: History is selective. What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened, but what historians have selected. They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made. Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history lessons.

questions.title: Parents attend school conference
questions.content: Schools host parent teacher conferences four times a year and it is important for families to attend. This is your chance to meet with teachers and ask questions about your child's progress. It can be helpful to write down questions ahead of time.

questions.title: Making notes
questions.content: The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning. It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions. Also, going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.

questions.title: Voyage
questions.content: A crew of scientists voyaged by ship from the southern tip of Chile into the frigid Antarctic to search for clues to one of the great unknowns of climate change. They planned to crisscross a remote patch of sea near the spot where, a year earlier, another crew had injected a tankful of an inert chemical one mile below the surface.

questions.title: Language
questions.content: It seems that language appeared from nowhere since no other species has anything resembling human language. However, other animals do possess basic systems for perceiving and producing sounds that enable them to communicate. These systems may have been in place before the appearance of language.

questions.title: Community Gardens
questions.content: Around the world, city residents build gardens on balconies, rooftops and small strips of land. A March 2023 study published in the journal Ecology Letters confirms that beyond offering food and an outlet for cultivating outdoor space, urban gardens provide benefits for the humans, insects, and animals who inhabit these leafy respites from city life.

questions.title: Liverpool
questions.content: Located at the heart of two world famous cities, Liverpool and London, Liverpool's excellence in teaching, learning and research, first-class facilities and outstanding support places the university in the top 1% of universities worldwide. The University of Liverpool will provide you with an inspiring student experience, in a diverse international community.

questions.title: Productive Capacity
questions.content: The core of the problem was the immense disparity between the country's productive capacity and the ability of people to consume. Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and wage earners.

questions.title: Tutor
questions.content: Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way. All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course, direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals.

questions.title: Breeding Areas
questions.content: Major breeding areas, and breeding islands, are shown as dark green areas or darts. Open darts are shown no-breeding records on islands, and are also used for offshore sightings, that is from ships or boats. Other areas where species are not meant to be seen are plain pale green, with pale green hatching where records are usually sparse.

questions.title: Learning Method
questions.content: There is no single method of learning that guarantees success. How we learn that depends on many different factors. And what works best for you will not necessarily be the same as the approach used for the other students even they study the same course. We are all unique as learners, although some patterns emerge from any groups of students.

questions.title: Revising Topics
questions.content: In classes, your teachers will talk about topics that you are studying. The information that they provide will be important to know when you take tests. You must be able to take good written notes from what your teachers say.

questions.title: Atlantis
questions.content: For centuries, Atlantis has been one of the western world's favorite legends, a tantalizing blend of fantasy and mystery. Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea – where some hope its ruins still lie, waiting to be discovered.

questions.title: Studying Abroad
questions.content: Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family. Most people believe that the overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills. While this may be true, not all of the new experiences are useful for finding a job. Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and knowledge more than cultural background.

questions.title: Summerhill School
questions.content: Founded in 1921 by A.S. Neill, the Summerhill School is known for its unique approach to education. At Summerhill, students have the freedom to choose their own activities and are encouraged to participate in the decision-making process. This student-centered approach promotes self-expression, creativity, and personal development.

questions.title: Tesla
questions.content: Tesla's theoretical work formed the basis of modern alternating current electric power systems. paragraphs.text: The intention was to record as much music as possible as quickly as possible, before encroaching influences like radio and cinema began transforming the region's distinctive culture.
